abstract: PURPOSE: To identify prognostic variables and outcomes in patients with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor (PMNSGCT) with postchemotherapy resection of persistent cancer. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Forty-seven consecutive patients with residual cancer after resection of PMNSGCT were retrospectively reviewed. Univariate comparisons were performed. RESULTS: At diagnosis, 43 patients had elevated serum tumor markers (STMs), and 20 had extramediastinal disease. At resection, 21 patients had elevated STMs. After resection, 26 patients had germ cell tumors (GCT), 12 had malignant transformation of teratoma with elements of non-GCT, and nine had both GCT and non-GCT. Sixteen of 47 patients continuously have no evidence of disease (NED). This includes eight of 26 patients with GCT histology and two of 12 patients with non-GCT histology. Of 27 patients with mediastinal-only disease at presentation, 14 have continuously NED. Of 20 patients with extramediastinal disease at presentation, two have continuously NED. Seven of 21 patients with elevated STMs at time of resection have continuously NED. Sixteen patients received adjuvant chemotherapy, and seven have continuously NED. Overall, 16 of 47 patients have continuously NED, an additional four patients have NED with further therapy (currently NED), two patients are alive with disease, 23 patients died of disease, and two patients died postoperatively. CONCLUSION: The presence of elevated STMs at resection does not appear to alter outcome if residual disease is completely resected. In this poor-risk patient population, surgical resection of persistent cancer, even in the presence of elevated STMs, can still achieve long-term survival.
abstract_ja:
目的: 原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(PMNSGCT)の化学療法後に残存癌を切除された患者における予後因子と転帰を同定すること。
患者と方法: 残存癌を切除されたPMNSGCT患者47例を後方視的に検討した。単変量解析を行った。
結果: 診断時、43例で血清腫瘍マーカー(STM)が上昇しており、20例は縦隔外病変を有していた。切除時には21例でSTMが上昇していた。切除後、26例は胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)、12例は奇形腫の悪性転化で非GCT成分を伴うもの、9例はGCTと非GCTの両方の組織像であった。47例中16例が無病状態(NED)を継続している。このうち、GCT組織型の26例中8例、非GCT組織型の12例中2例が含まれる。診断時に縦隔病変のみであった27例中14例が継続的NEDである。縦隔外病変を有していた20例中2例が継続的NEDである。切除時にSTMが上昇していた21例中7例が継続的NEDである。補助化学療法を受けた16例中7例が継続的NEDである。全体では、47例中16例が継続的NED、さらに4例が追加治療後NED(現在NED)、2例が担癌生存、23例が癌死、2例が術後死亡であった。
結論: 残存病変が完全切除される場合、切除時のSTM上昇は転帰に影響しないようである。このような予後不良の患者集団においても、残存癌の外科的切除により長期生存が得られうる。
